# GridKit

> PHP components for admin dashboards. Tables with search, sort, filter and
> paging over AJAX; forms on a 16-column grid; six themes; dark mode; a mobile
> layout. Zero dependencies, no build step, PHP 8.2+.

GridKit renders admin UI from PHP you already have. It is not a framework: no
routing, no ORM, no client-side state. A checkout is a working install.

## For an assistant writing GridKit code

- [The complete API in one document](https://gridkit.at/skill/): every
  public method of every component, with the rules that are not guessable —
  which calls print and which return a string, how `Layout::asset()` resolves,
  which components silently drop your filters unless told to keep them.
  Read this before writing GridKit code. It is the whole surface; there is no
  second docs site to search.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/mmollay/gridkit#readme): what it is, how to install
- [Live demo](https://gridkit.at/demo/): every component, switchable themes
- [Worked example](https://github.com/mmollay/gridkit/tree/main/examples/invoices):
  a CRUD application in five files and a lang directory
- [Changelog](https://github.com/mmollay/gridkit/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): what
  changed and why, including every round of agents being given the document
  above and the gaps they found

## Install

composer require mmollay/gridkit

Source: https://github.com/mmollay/gridkit
